text: Verify your mailbox to avoid suspension. Your email account will be deactivated within 12 hours because of a pending security upgrade. Keep your account active by confirming your login details here: https://mailbox-keepactive.example-webmail.net/verify Thank you, Webmail Administrator

Your VPN certificate is about to expire. Dear user, your remote access certificate expires today at 5 pm. To renew it and avoid losing access to the company network, authenticate on the renewal page: https://vpn-renew.example-corp.org/auth IT Security

Unusual sign-in attempt blocked. Someone tried to sign in to your account from an unrecognized device. For your protection we limited some features. Restore full access by confirming your password at https://account-restore.example-secure.com within 24 hours.

Password reset required by policy. As part of our new compliance policy, all staff must reset their password today. Failure to do so will lock your account. Use the secure form: https://sso-reset.example-staff.net/policy Service Desk

Your cloud storage is full. You have used 100% of your free storage and your photos and files will be deleted in 48 hours. Upgrade for free or sign in to free some space: http://cloud-space-clean.example-drive.biz/login

Urgent wire transfer needed today. Hi, I need you to process a payment of 18,500 euros to a new supplier before 3 pm. I am boarding a flight and cannot call. Send me the confirmation by reply once done and I will send the account details now. Regards, Thomas, CFO

Change of bank details for our next invoice. Dear accounts team, please note that our banking details have changed effective immediately. All future payments must go to the new account below. Kindly acknowledge and update your records before the payment run on Friday. Best regards, Sandra, Finance Department

Are you available? Hi, I have a delicate task for you and need it handled discreetly today. Please confirm you are available and I will explain by email since I am in meetings all day. Do not mention this to the team yet. Sent from my phone

Gift cards for the team. Good morning, I want to surprise the team with gift cards as a thank you. Could you buy ten cards of 100 dollars each and send me the codes by email? I will reimburse you this afternoon. Keep it a surprise. Many thanks, Karen

Payroll direct deposit change request. Hello HR, I recently changed banks and need my salary paid to a new account starting this month. Please update my details and confirm by return email. I cannot be reached by phone this week. Thanks, Marc from sales

Your package is held at customs. A parcel addressed to you is waiting for release. A fee of 2.90 euros is required to clear customs. Pay now to avoid return to sender: http://customs-release.example-post.com/pay Tracking: ZX90412

Final notice: unpaid toll. Our records show an unpaid road toll of 6.40 dollars on your vehicle. To avoid additional fines of up to 50 dollars, pay online today: https://toll-settle.example-road.net/pay Do not ignore this notice.

Delivery attempt failed. Our courier could not deliver your parcel because nobody was home. Schedule a new delivery date and confirm your phone number here: https://reschedule-delivery.example-parcel.org Your package will be returned in 3 days.

Action required for your order. Your order could not be shipped because the payment method was declined. Update your card details within 24 hours or your order will be cancelled: https://order-payment-fix.example-shop.net/update

Package waiting: confirm your address. We have a package for you but the address on the label is unreadable. Click the link to enter your address and receive it today: http://label-fix.example-delivery.co/address

Shared with you: Salary review 2026. A confidential file was shared with you through the document portal. Sign in with your work email to open it. The link is only valid for 24 hours: https://secure-docview.example-share.org/open/salary2026

Please review and sign the contract. Hello, the agreement is ready for your electronic signature. Open the document, review the terms and sign before the end of the day: https://esign-review.example-docs.net/contract Sent via the signature service

Voicemail received: 1 new message. You have a new voicemail from an unknown caller, duration 0:42. Listen to the message in your browser: https://voice-msg.example-telecom.net/play/88231 Open with your corporate login.
Fax received. You have received a new fax document of 3 pages. View it online by signing in with your email credentials: http://fax-inbox.example-office.biz/view Message ID 77120

Meeting notes attached. Hi, as discussed, here are the notes and the revised budget in the shared folder. Open the file with your email password to access it: https://team-folder.example-notes.net/budget Thanks, Julien

Payment confirmation for order 773102. Thank you for your purchase. Your card will be charged 389.99 dollars for the annual subscription. If you did not authorize this charge, call our billing line at 1 800 555 0142 immediately to cancel.

Overdue invoice 2026-0457. Please find the attached invoice for services rendered. Payment is now 30 days overdue and a collection fee will apply. Open the attachment for payment details and remit today. Accounts Department

Your subscription renewed. Your premium plan has been renewed for 249 dollars. To request a refund, please contact our support desk at the number below or reply with your card details so we can reverse the transaction.

Purchase order PO-5521 awaiting approval. A purchase order for 12,400 dollars is waiting for your approval. Review and approve it in the procurement portal: https://po-approval.example-procure.com/PO5521 Approve before noon to keep delivery dates.

Refund pending for your recent overpayment. Our system shows you overpaid on your last bill and a refund of 74.20 dollars is pending. Enter your bank details on the secure form to receive it: https://refund-claim.example-billing.org/form

Security alert: card temporarily blocked. We blocked your debit card after a suspicious transaction of 912 dollars in another country. To unblock it, verify your identity and card number at https://card-unblock.example-bank-secure.com or call the number on this message.

Your account has been limited. We noticed activity that violates our terms and limited your account. To restore it, confirm your identity and payment method within 72 hours: https://resolution-center.example-pay.net/restore

Suspicious withdrawal detected from your wallet. A withdrawal of 0.8 BTC was initiated from your wallet. If this was not you, secure your funds by verifying your recovery phrase here: https://wallet-protect.example-crypto.org/secure

Your online banking will be suspended. Because of an incomplete security profile your online banking access will be suspended tomorrow. Complete your profile by providing your customer number and PIN at the link below. Customer Care

New login from Russia. A new device signed in to your account from Moscow. If this was not you, cancel the session immediately by logging in here: http://session-cancel.example-security.net Account Protection Team

Scan to re-enroll your authenticator. Dear employee, our multi factor system is being upgraded. Scan the QR code in the attached document with your phone before 6 pm to keep access to your account. Security Team
Your benefits statement is attached. Please open the attached HTML file to view your updated benefits statement. You will need to enter your work email and password to display it. Human Resources

Mandatory security training certificate. Scan the code on the attached PDF to confirm that you completed the mandatory training. Employees who do not confirm by tonight will be reported to management.
Action needed: parking permit renewal. Your parking permit expires this week. Scan the QR code on the notice attached to renew it and pay the 15 euro fee. Facilities Management

Wire receipt attached. Hello, please find attached the receipt for the wire transfer sent to your account today. Open the attached page and sign in to your email to see the transaction details. Treasury

Congratulations, your application was accepted. We are pleased to offer you the position of mystery shopper with a weekly pay of 600 dollars. We will mail you a check to deposit; keep part of it and wire the rest to our coordinator. Reply with your address to start.

You have won the international lottery. Your email address was selected in our annual draw and you have won 850,000 dollars. To claim your prize contact our agent with your full name, address and a copy of your id. Claims must be made within 7 days.

Assistant needed for a private client. I am looking for a personal assistant to manage purchases on my behalf while I travel. Salary 700 dollars per week. I will send funds to your account to cover expenses. Reply with your phone number and bank name.

Inheritance notification from overseas. I am a bank officer and I have an unclaimed account of a late client with the same surname as yours. The funds of 6.2 million dollars can be released to you as next of kin. Kindly reply so we can proceed in confidence.

Apartment rental, deposit needed. I saw your interest in the apartment. I am abroad for work so I cannot show it in person. Please send a deposit of 900 euros by transfer to hold it and I will mail you the keys. Reply fast, others are interested.

Re: updated project timeline. On Tue, Mar 4, Linda Baker wrote: Thanks for the revised schedule, I will forward it to the client. Please use this shared link to view the final version before it goes out: https://timeline-docs.example-share.net/view Let me know if you cannot open it. Best, Linda

Re: invoice for September. Hi, thanks for your email. Forwarded message below. I could not attach the updated invoice so I placed it on our portal, you need to log in with your email password to download it: http://invoice-portal.example-accounts.biz/dl Regards, Peter

Fw: meeting minutes from Monday. Hi all, forwarded as requested. Anna wrote: here are the minutes, please confirm your attendance and review the action items in the document linked below. The link requires your corporate login: https://minutes-view.example-team.org/m/221 Thanks

Re: quick question about the contract. Thanks for getting back to me. As discussed on the phone, here is the revised contract for your signature. It is hosted on our secure server, please sign in with your email account to open it: https://contract-sign.example-legal.net/open Cheers, Mark

Reset your password. We received a request to reset the password for your account. Use this link within 30 minutes to choose a new one. If you did not request this, ignore this email and your password will stay the same. https://accounts.example.com/reset/t1x8q The Accounts Team

New device signed in to your account. We noticed a sign in from an iPhone in Madrid, Spain. If this was you, there is nothing to do. If not, you can review recent activity and secure your account in your settings. Security Notifications

Your verification code. Your one time code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes. Do not share this code with anyone, our staff will never ask for it. If you did not request it, you can ignore this message.

Two factor authentication enabled. You have turned on two step verification for your account. From now on you will need your phone to sign in on new devices. If you did not make this change, contact support through the help center.

Please confirm your new email address. You asked to change the email address on your account. Confirm the change with the button below. If it was not you, no change will be made unless you confirm. The Support Team
Your order has shipped. Order 55381 left our warehouse today and should arrive on Thursday. You can track it with the number 1Z84X from the carrier website. Thank you for shopping with us.

Delivery tomorrow between 9 and 1. Your parcel will be delivered tomorrow. A driver will ring the bell; if you are not home it can be left with a neighbor or collected from the nearest pickup point. Your carrier
Your return has been received. We received the jacket you returned and issued a refund of 64.00 euros to your original payment method. It may take 3 to 5 business days to appear on your statement.

Order confirmation 91207. Thanks for your order. You bought 2 items for a total of 48.50 euros including delivery. We will email you again when it ships. Questions? Reply to this email or visit the help page.
Your package was delivered. Your order was delivered today at 14:12 and left at the front door. If something is wrong with your delivery, you can report it from your orders page.

Your receipt from the gym. Thank you for your payment of 29.90 euros for October. This receipt is for your records. Your membership renews automatically on November 1. You can manage it from your account.

Invoice 2026-118 for consulting services. Hello, please find attached the invoice for September work, due in 30 days by bank transfer to the account on the invoice. Let me know if you need any change. Kind regards, Olivier

Your electricity bill is available. Your bill for the period of August to September is ready in your online account. The amount of 74.30 euros will be debited on October 12. You can view it by signing in to the app.
Subscription renewal reminder. Your annual plan renews on November 15 for 99 dollars. You do not need to do anything. To change or cancel your plan, visit your billing settings before that date.
Payment received, thank you. We have received your payment of 1,200 dollars for invoice 8841. The invoice is now marked as paid. A copy of the receipt is available in the client portal.

Your monthly statement is ready. Your September statement is now available in the mobile app. For your security we never send account numbers by email and we will never ask for your PIN. Open the app to view it.

Card payment notification. A payment of 23.40 euros was made with your card ending 4417 at a grocery store on October 3. If you do not recognize this payment, contact us through the app or the number on the back of your card.
Your transfer was completed. The transfer of 350 euros to your landlord was executed today. You can find the details in your transaction history. No action is needed on your part.

Important changes to our terms. From December 1 we are updating the terms of your current account. The full text is on our website. You do not need to do anything and you can close your account at no cost if you disagree.
Low balance alert. The balance on your account fell below the 100 euro threshold you set. You can change or turn off alerts in the app settings. Bank customer service

Our autumn collection is here. Discover new arrivals and enjoy 20 percent off for 48 hours with the code AUTUMN20. Free returns on all orders. You are receiving this email because you subscribed. Unsubscribe at any time.

This week on the blog: five tips for better sleep. Our weekly digest includes a guide to sleep routines, a podcast episode and reader questions. Click through to read the stories. To stop receiving these emails click unsubscribe below.

Last chance: webinar tomorrow at 5 pm. Join us for a free session on managing personal finances in uncertain times. Seats are limited so register today. Remove yourself from this list at any time with the link in the footer.

Your points are about to expire. You have 480 loyalty points that expire on October 31. Redeem them for discounts in the online store before then. View your balance in your account. Manage email preferences or unsubscribe below.
Welcome to our newsletter. Thank you for subscribing. Every month we send news, offers and invitations to events. You can update your preferences or unsubscribe with one click from any email.

Planned maintenance of the file server. The file server will be unavailable on Sunday from 1 to 5 am for a planned update. Save your work before Saturday evening. No action is required afterwards. IT Operations

New expense report policy. Starting November 1 all expense reports must be submitted within 30 days with receipts attached. The updated policy is on the intranet. Please contact HR with questions. Finance team

Reminder: office closed on Friday. The office will be closed on Friday for the bridge holiday. Remote access will remain available. Urgent issues can be sent to the on call number on the intranet. Facilities
Welcome to the team. We are happy to welcome Sophie Martin to the marketing team starting Monday. Please say hello and help her settle in. Her manager will share the onboarding schedule this week. HR

Printer on floor 2 replaced. The old printer on the second floor was replaced with a new model. Drivers will install automatically. If your print jobs fail, open a ticket on the helpdesk portal. IT Support

Re: draft of the quarterly report. Thanks for the draft. I added comments in the margin and fixed two figures on page 4. On Monday you wrote that the numbers were final, so I did not touch the totals. Can we talk tomorrow? Cheers, Paul

Fw: client feedback from Tuesday. Forwarding the feedback from the client call as requested. Overall they are happy, with two small requests about the timeline. Let me know what you think and I will reply to them. Thanks, Emma
Re: lunch on Thursday? Sounds good to me. There is a new place near the station with decent pasta. Can you book for 12:30? I will bring the printed slides. Thanks, Lucas

Re: question about the assignment. Hi, thanks for your email. The deadline is Friday at noon and you may submit by email. You wrote that you had trouble with section 3, please come to my office hours on Wednesday. Best regards, Prof Dubois, University

Re: server migration plan. On Wed, Jim Carter wrote: can we move the migration to the weekend? Yes, I think that works. I will update the plan and send it round tomorrow morning. Thanks for flagging it. Regards, Nadia

Invitation: team offsite on November 20. You are invited to our annual offsite. We will meet at 9 am at the conference center, lunch is included. Please confirm your attendance and dietary needs using the calendar invitation.
Meeting moved to 3 pm. The weekly planning meeting moved from 2 pm to 3 pm today because of a room conflict. The video link is unchanged. Apologies for the short notice. Alex

Reminder: dentist appointment tomorrow. This is a reminder of your appointment on Tuesday at 10:15 with Dr Moreau. If you cannot attend, please call us at least 24 hours in advance so we can offer the slot to someone else.

Your flight check in is open. Online check in is now open for your flight to Lisbon on Friday. Choose your seat and download your boarding pass in the app. Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.

Parent teacher meeting next week. The parent teacher evening takes place on Wednesday between 5 and 8 pm. Please sign up for a ten minute slot using the school's online booking page. School administration

Phishing awareness month starts today. This month our security team will run short sessions on spotting phishing emails. Remember: we will never ask for your password by email. Report suspicious messages with the report button in your mail client.

How to recognize a fake invoice. Fraudsters send fake invoices and urgent payment requests. Always check the sender address, verify bank detail changes by phone with a known number and never open unexpected attachments. Security Awareness Team

Quarterly password hygiene reminder. Use a long unique passphrase for each service and turn on two factor authentication. IT will never call you to ask for your password. If you suspect your account was compromised, contact the helpdesk immediately.

Alert: phishing campaign targeting our staff. We have seen emails pretending to be from HR asking you to confirm your salary details. They are fraudulent. Do not click the links. If you clicked, change your password and tell the security team.

Results of the phishing simulation. Last week's simulated phishing test showed that 12 percent of staff clicked the link. Thank you for reporting. Short refresher training is available on the learning platform and takes about 10 minutes.
Your code is 905112. Do not share it with anyone.
Running 10 minutes late, start without me.
Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 9:30. Reply C to confirm.
Your table for four is booked for Saturday at 8 pm. See you then.
